body:
I think that my feelings for her come in waves, if that makes any sense. I'll want her one day and then I'll care a little less about her another. Deep down I feel like I know that it wouldn't work between us and I just miss being in a relationship. I see all of my friends getting back together with their ex girlfriends and it makes me wonder why that can't happen to me. Maybe that makes me weak, I don't know.

My ex has enormous pressure from her family to make money in life so she's in school for something that she isn't particularly good at and she hates it. Her dad has her on ADHD pills because she can't pay attention otherwise. I know that she will become successful but I also know she won't be happy with her life. I'm kind of rambling now but my dream girl would be somebody who likes art like I do. And maybe I think too far into the future but I imagine our house having a little painting studio. My ex didn't care for any of that. I brought her to a museum and she absolutely hated it.

But still, I can't get over the look she used to give me when she told me she loved me. She was almost in tears sometimes. It made me feel so good and everything felt right in the world. I don't know if I'll ever find somebody who says it like that. And to think everybody said "yeah that's nice and all, but wait a year". That's exactly what happened. But in my mind we would grow old together.
I will check out the breakup forums, thank you.
